purpose: Teach: プログラマー/ユーティリティ/短大/本学/南側/伝送/陳列/懲戒

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プログラマー職の求人広告を出しましょう
lines.en: Let's put out a job posting for a programmer position.
lines.style: Clear, decisive opening. Brisk forward momentum. No hesitation — she knows what needs doing. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ユーティリティ部品の在庫を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll check the inventory on utility parts.
lines.style: Responsive and prompt. Slight nod of understanding in the voice. Ready to move to the next thing. Efficient without rushing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 短大卒の社員のキャリアパスも整備しましょう
lines.en: We should also set up a clear career path for junior college graduates.
lines.style: Thoughtful, building on momentum. Slight pause before the main idea — she's thinking ahead. Gentle direction, not a demand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本学関係の同窓会で広報します
lines.en: Yes. I'll use the alumni network to get the word out.
lines.style: Understanding the implication immediately. Warm agreement. Slight uptick in energy — he's problem-solving as he speaks.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 南側エントランスの装飾を変えましょう
lines.en: Let's refresh the decoration at the south entrance.
lines.style: Calm authority. Matter-of-fact. Moving to the next item on the list. Professional ease — this is routine leadership.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。映像の伝送品質を改善します
lines.en: Yes. I'll improve the video transmission quality.
lines.style: Clipped, professional. Acknowledging and moving. No elaboration needed — he's tracking what's being asked and taking it on.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 店舗の陳列を季節商品に変えましょう
lines.en: Let's update the store displays for seasonal products.
lines.style: Same calm authority as before. Rhythmic — she's worked into a steady cadence of direction. Clear and grounded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。懲戒委員会の手続きを共有します
lines.en: Got it. I'll share the disciplinary committee procedures with you.
lines.style: Closing phrase. Slightly more weight — this is the final item. Steady and responsible. The understated signal that he's handling the harder things too.
